technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with isolated bullish signals (supertrend, CMF cross) are overwhelmed by pervasive bearish structure (all MAs bearish, price below cloud, weak ADX); insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: LHX shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 prior sales) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (329.92) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings event in 28 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9) combined with supertrend bullish signal and CMF cross-up in fear-zone sentiment (16/100) creates classic contrarian reversal setup near support at 194.66.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, weak ADX trend, low volume confirmation) combined with crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, and 28-day earnings event creates unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and supertrend bullish signal present contrarian setup, but pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, weak ADX) combined with crisis macro conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 329.92) creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: 28-day earnings event combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and crisis-level VIX creates binary downside risk that overwhelms isolated oversold bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
